full_text: Republic 01' the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condoniinium II Bldg. EDSA corner Mapagnnahal Street, l)iliman, Quezon City OPINION NO. IJ2 S. 2010 HON. ARTEMIO B. SERDON, JR. Councilor/Chairman Committee on Environmental Protection Sta. Elena, Camarines Norte Dear Hon. Serdon: This pertains to your letter-query seeking the legal opinion from this Department on the propriety of Provincial Ordinance No. 53-2005 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Camarines Norte. In reply thereto, since Provincial Ordinance No. 53-2005 has already been approved by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, we are of the view that the same should be accorded the presumption of validity unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issues or questions thereon relative to its non-compliance with the substantive requirements in the passage of Provincial Ordinance No. 53-2005 should already be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory: Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provide and we quote: "Section 1. Who may file petition — Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional Trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder." We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: ATTY. JESUS DOQU V Director III cc.: The Regional Director DILG, Region V Rizal St., Legaspi City Legal: 28/ Merle
